verdict.rationale: Carta is an equity-management and valuations product, so non-US valuations and country-specific option plans are a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence only covers US 409A valuations and fair market values. Nothing in the pack mentions UK HMRC/EMI valuations, other non-US valuation regimes, or country-specific option schemes for international entities.

support.subject: As an ops user, non-US valuations and schemes — UK HMRC/EMI valuations, country-specific option plans — are supported for my international entities
